observations.desc: Email with a credential-harvesting link addressed to a.rossi@contoso.example; the mail gateway quarantined it before delivery.
The linked page imitates the organization's sign-in page and posts what is typed to a host registered four days earlier.

Message trace for the sender and the link over the window: four copies; three quarantined, one delivered to the inbox of m.bianchi@contoso.example eleven minutes before the gateway's rule caught the sender.
The device of m.bianchi requested the link's host and posted a form to it two minutes after the delivery.

observations.what: a copy of the message, in the inbox of m.bianchi@contoso.example
what m.bianchi typed into the form the page posts to the attacker's host

reach.desc: The gateway held the alerted copy, and another copy of the same message was delivered to a person who opened the link.
